WITH gn_uti AS (

  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co

  )

), drug_classes AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, 'carbapenem' AS class_name
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1709170,1717963,1778262,1713905)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, 'narrow' AS class_name
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1771162,1786621,920293,1705674,1836430,1713332,1717327)
), initial_rx AS (
  SELECT g.person_id, g.index_date, dc.class_name, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS first_rx_date
  FROM gn_uti g
  JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id = g.person_id
  JOIN drug_classes dc ON dc.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day, -1, g.index_date) AND DATEADD(day, 3, g.index_date)
  GROUP BY g.person_id, g.index_date, dc.class_name
), classified AS (
  SELECT person_id, index_date,
    CASE
      WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN class_name='carbapenem' THEN first_rx_date END) IS NOT NULL
       AND (MIN(CASE WHEN class_name='narrow' THEN first_rx_date END) IS NULL OR MIN(CASE WHEN class_name='carbapenem' THEN first_rx_date END) <= MIN(CASE WHEN class_name='narrow' THEN first_rx_date END)) THEN 'carbapenem'
      WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN class_name='narrow' THEN first_rx_date END) IS NOT NULL THEN 'narrow'
    END AS initial_therapy
  FROM initial_rx
  GROUP BY person_id, index_date
), outcomes AS (
  SELECT c.person_id, c.index_date, c.initial_therapy,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co2
      WHERE co2.person_id = c.person_id
        AND co2.condition_concept_id IN (
          SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor
          WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4116491,37016369,37016370,4114033,4247613)

WITH gn_events AS (
  SELECT person_id, condition_start_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (4116491,37016369,37016370,4114033,4247613)
), gn_uti AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM gn_events
  GROUP BY person_id
), drug_classes AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, 'carbapenem' AS class_name
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1709170,1717963,1778262,1713905)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, 'narrow' AS class_name
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1771162,1786621,920293,1705674,1836430,1713332,1717327)
), initial_rx AS (
  SELECT g.person_id, g.index_date,
         MIN(CASE WHEN dc.class_name='carbapenem' THEN de.drug_exposure_start_date END) AS carb_date,
         MIN(CASE WHEN dc.class_name='narrow' THEN de.drug_exposure_start_date END) AS narrow_date
  FROM gn_uti g
  JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id = g.person_id
    AND de.drug_exposure_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day, -1, g.index_date) AND DATEADD(day, 3, g.index_date)
  JOIN drug_classes dc ON dc.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  GROUP BY g.person_id, g.index_date
), classified AS (
  SELECT person_id, index_date,
    CASE WHEN carb_date IS NOT NULL AND (narrow_date IS NULL OR carb_date <= narrow_date) THEN 'carbapenem'
         WHEN narrow_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'narrow' END AS initial_therapy
  FROM initial_rx
), rec AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.person_id, c.index_date
  FROM classified c
  JOIN gn_events e ON e.person_id = c.person_id
    AND e.condition_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day, 14, c.index_date) AND DATEADD(day, 60, c.index_date)
)
SELECT c.initial_therapy, COUNT(*) AS patients, COUNT(r.person_id) AS recurrent_patients,
       CAST(100.0 * COUNT(r.person_id) / COUNT(*) AS decimal(6,2)) AS recurrence_percent
FROM classified c
LEFT JOIN rec r ON r.person_id = c.person_id AND r.index_date = c.index_date
WHERE c.initial_therapy IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.initial_therapy
ORDER BY c.initial_therapy;

No — in this crude OMOP query, initial carbapenem therapy was associated with *higher*, not lower, 60-day recurrence.

Result:

| Initial therapy | Patients | 14–60 day recurrent UTI | Recurrence |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Carbapenem | 164 | 46 | 28.05% |
| Narrow-spectrum | 697 | 118 | 16.93% |

Definition used:
- Gram-negative UTI index concepts: E. coli UTI, Klebsiella UTI, Pseudomonas UTI, Proteus UTI, Pseudomonas cystitis.
- Initial therapy: drug exposure from 1 day before to 3 days after index UTI.
- Carbapenems: meropenem, ertapenem, imipenem, doripenem descendants.
- Narrow-spectrum comparator: cefazolin, cephalexin, nitrofurantoin, TMP-SMX ingredients, amoxicillin, ampicillin descendants.
- Recurrence: another gram-negative UTI condition record 14–60 days after index.

Interpretation: this does **not** support a recurrence-reduction benefit for initial carbapenems. However, this is likely confounded by indication: carbapenems are probably given to sicker patients or resistant/complicated infections. A causal answer would need adjustment for baseline severity, resistance/ESBL history, hospitalization, catheter/urologic abnormalities, prior UTI, prior antibiotics, and culture susceptibility.
